description: Every infinite \(L\)-structure \(M\) has an elementary embedding \(e:M\to N\) and an element \(b\in N\) outside \(e[M]\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.LargerModels.proper_elementary_extension.{u} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {M : Type u}
  [L.Structure M] [Infinite M] : ∃ N e b, ∀ (a : M), e a ≠ b
